parameters.name: orderType
parameters.description: 订单类型，可选值： 订购 BUY ：订购。 续订 RENEW ：续订，仅包周期付费实例可选。 架构变更 UPGRADE ：架构变更，如标准版变更为Cluster集群版。 纵向扩展 EXPANSION ：实例/分片规格扩容（适用：StandardDual/DirectCluster/ClusterOriginalProxy/OriginalMultipleReadLvs）。 CONTRACTION ：实例/分片规格缩容（适用：同上）。 横向扩展 INCREASE_SHARDS ：增加集群分片（适用：DirectCluster/ClusterOriginalProxy）。 DECREASE_SHARDS ：减少集群分片（适用：同上）。 副本调整 INCREASE_REPLICAS ：增加数据副本（适用：StandardDual/DirectCluster/ClusterOriginalProxy/OriginalMultipleReadLvs）。 DECREASE_REPLICAS ：减少数据副本（适用：同上）

descriptions.zh-CN: 订单类型，可选值： 订购 BUY ：订购。 续订 RENEW ：续订，仅包周期付费实例可选。 架构变更 UPGRADE ：架构变更，如标准版变更为Cluster集群版。 纵向扩展 EXPANSION ：实例/分片规格扩容（适用：StandardDual/DirectCluster/ClusterOriginalProxy/OriginalMultipleReadLvs）。 CONTRACTION ：实例/分片规格缩容（适用：同上）。 横向扩展 INCREASE_SHARDS ：增加集群分片（适用：DirectCluster/ClusterOriginalProxy）。 DECREASE_SHARDS ：减少集群分片（适用：同上）。 副本调整 INCREASE_REPLICAS ：增加数据副本（适用：StandardDual/DirectCluster/ClusterOriginalProxy/OriginalMultipleReadLvs）。 DECREASE_REPLICAS ：减少数据副本（适用：同上）

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: 检索语句（云日志查询语法），直接透传至云日志检索接口。不传或为空时默认导出全部日志。语法规则详见[云日志查询语法](https://www.ctyun.cn/document/10261471/10379884)。 支持的字段及构造规则： clientIp：客户端IP:端口，支持通配符 `*`（匹配多个字符）和 `?`（匹配单个字符），不可用于词首，如 clientIp:192.168* accountName：用户账号，精确匹配，多值用 OR 连接，如 accountName:"default" command：命令名称，支持通配符 `*` 和 `?`，不可用于词首，如 command:SET* db：数据库编号，精确匹配，多值用 OR 连接，如 db:"0" cost：执行时长（微秒μs），范围查询，支持比较运算符或 in 语法，如 cost in [1000 5000] 或 cost >= 1000 and cost 多条件用 and 或 or 连接，如 clientIp:192.168* and command:SET* 支持 not 非运算、( ) 分组优先级控制 不传或为空时默认导出全部日志

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: 检索语句（云日志查询语法），直接透传至云日志检索接口。不传或为空时默认导出全部日志。语法规则详见[云日志查询语法](https://www.ctyun.cn/document/10261471/10379884)。 支持的字段及构造规则： clientIp：客户端IP:端口，支持通配符 `*`（匹配多个字符）和 `?`（匹配单个字符），不可用于词首，如 clientIp:192.168* accountName：用户账号，精确匹配，多值用 OR 连接，如 accountName:"default" command：命令名称，支持通配符 `*` 和 `?`，不可用于词首，如 command:SET* db：数据库编号，精确匹配，多值用 OR 连接，如 db:"0" cost：执行时长（微秒μs），范围查询，支持比较运算符或 in 语法，如 cost in [1000 5000] 或 cost >= 1000 and cost 多条件用 and 或 or 连接，如 clientIp:192.168* and command:SET* 支持 not 非运算、( ) 分组优先级控制 不传或为空时默认导出全部日志

redis.instance.running.evidence: API 23430 documents integer status: 0 effective/running; 4 provisioning failed, 8 unsubscribed, 10 restart failed. Provisioning, paused, resizing, stopping, stopped, restarting, network change, destruction and unknown states remain pending.

redis.node.running.evidence: API 23767 documents integer node status: 0 running, 1 stopped. No failure state is documented; stopped and unknown remain pending. Both instance ID and node name are required.

redis.migration.complete.evidence: API 17901 documents integer task status: 0 initial, 1 running, 2 succeeded, 3 failed. taskId is required and the response is a single task object.

redis.task.complete.evidence: API 17918: integer status 0 initial, 1 running, 2 success, 3 failure, 4 cancelled. Required taskId identifies the single result object; unknown states remain pending.

redis.flashback.complete.evidence: API 19861: status 0 not started, 1 restoring, 2 succeeded, 3 failed. Documentation calls it an Integer; captured response uses string "0". The instance-specific scalar state is compared canonically without changing captured values.

redis.legacy.node.running.evidence: API 19552: integer status 0 running, 1 stopped; no failure state documented. Required instance ID, node type and node address identify the retrieval.

redis.backup.complete.evidence: API 7778: backup status success, processing, fail; selects returnObj.rows by exact restoreName and requires the existing restore-name input before polling.

redis.backup.restored.evidence: API 7778: recoveryStatus success, processing, fail, create. create is preparation and remains pending. Exact restoreName selects a single backup row.

redis.instance.list.running.evidence: API 23786 documents status success 0 and failure states 4, 8, 10. Other and null states remain pending. Response nesting and identity are verified against its captured example. Requires the existing scalar identity input and selects its exact row; absent or duplicate matches cannot signal success.

redis.legacy.instance.list.running.evidence: API 7728 documents status success 0 and failure states 4, 8, 10. Other and null states remain pending. Response nesting and identity are verified against its captured example. Requires the existing scalar identity input and selects its exact row; absent or duplicate matches cannot signal success.

redis.legacy.dedicated-cluster.instance..evidence: API 7733 documents status success 0 and failure states 4, 8, 10. Other and null states remain pending. Response nesting and identity are verified against its captured example. Requires the existing scalar identity input and selects its exact row; absent or duplicate matches cannot signal success.

redis.legacy.instance.running.evidence: API 7729 documents returnObj.userInfo.status success 0 and failure states 4, 8, 10. Other and null states remain pending. Response nesting and identity are verified against its captured example.

redis.parameter.history.complete.evidence: API 15098 documents history.status success SUCCESS and failure states FAILED. Other and null states remain pending. Response nesting and identity are verified against its captured example. Requires the existing scalar identity input and selects its exact row; absent or duplicate matches cannot signal success.
